hypothesis: On every declared input, pilot-allocated frozen-direction ratio evaluation reduces end-to-end cost by at least 20% against complete-bank reconstruction at the same case-specific estimation accuracy and unconditional success lower bound.
evidence: ideal IID joint Pauli-shot simulation; independent occupation-sign molecular assessment; illustrative serial device pricing; no hardware or quantum advantage claim
scope: New cross-domain validation after the spin-only hypothesis closed negative. Known historical Hamiltonians are held out from tuning this new protocol, not blind external data. No old record or decision is superseded.
pair_transfer_convention: zero-based spatial indices; T_s_to_t=a†_(2t) a†_(2t+1) a_(2s+1) a_(2s); G=T-T† is anti-Hermitian; coefficients retain all Jordan-Wigner signs

preparation.molecule: cos(theta)|11110000> + exp(i*phi)sin(theta)|11001100>; fixed singlet pair occupations, no optimization; q0 leftmost
preparation.molecule_schedule: X0/X1 parallel with RY2; RZ2; three serial CX layers; final X2/X3 in parallel. Global phase immaterial.
preparation.accounting: TFIM d1=2,d2=0,2n one-qubit gates; molecule d1=3,d2=3,6 one-qubit and3 CNOT gates; explicit preparation layers add to per-qubit initialization envelope and readout compiler layers

span_policy: all three fixed generators; pilot overlap truncation learns retained frame and c; no evaluation refit or exact variance/coefficients in allocation
seed_rule: master_seed + 100000*case_index + 1000*budget_index + 3*replica + stream; stream0 common pilot,1 ratio evaluation,2 bank evaluation
pilot_allocation: uniform with integer remainders in setting order
ratio_allocation: Neyman sqrt(pilot group variance of f_H-E_pilot*f_S), minimum 2 per fresh evaluation setting, largest-remainder integer rounding
bank_allocation: Neyman sqrt(sum pilot group variances over independent real S/H entry functionals), minimum 2 per fresh evaluation setting, largest-remainder integer rounding
baseline: reconstruct all S/H entries from fresh complete-bank shots; evaluate the same frozen pilot c; no held-out refit; optional re-solve is not a decision input
ratio_interval: Bonferroni joint Hoeffding rectangle for f_H,f_S, transformed by four ratio corners only when denominator lower bound exceeds floor; covariance retained in point/delta diagnostic; no independence assumption between H and S
success_probability_rule: one-sided Clopper-Pearson binomial lower bounds, Bonferroni across all18 case/budget/arm cells; each target uses its declared physical unit
failure_rule: pilot/linear-algebra/nonfinite/denominator/memory failures remain in every128-attempt cell; all attempted work/shots charged; unavailable worker observations are failures, not selectively rerun
memory_scope: fresh subprocess per case; conservative owned-array/dense-workspace bound 128*12*4**n+16*4**n*2**n+8*16*4**n+2**20 bytes before case allocation; at n8=378535936 bytes; Python/allocator overhead excluded from array model and included in independent process RSS high-water observations
end_to_end_cost: serial illustrative device initialization + explicitly declared preparation gates/layers + compiled readout/readout-reset cost, plus measured model/provider setup, pilot validation/reconstruction/solve/freezing/allocation and evaluation reconstruction/inference; simulator draws and independent exact assessment excluded and separately timed; cost scopes retained for failed attempts
promotion_rule: for each arm/case choose cheapest frozen budget with simultaneous success lower bound >=.9 and no resource failure; require ratio cost <=.8*bank for ALL3 inputs. If either arm has no qualifying budget, matched-success cost is unavailable, never imputed. Otherwise close this hypothesis on its declared scope without new variants or budget extension.
assessment_only: After inference use independent tensor matrices for TFIM and occupation-sign FCIDUMP Hamiltonian plus independent S² for molecules; molecular reference/correction span and ground comparison restricted to N4,Sz0,S0. Never provide assessment energies, exact coefficients or variances to the consumer/allocation. Store c and retained frame to allow independent quotient/retained-space checks.
report_errors: estimation error around true frozen pilot-direction quotient
total ground-energy error in declared physical sector
record_policy: declaration and scientific sources committed before any outcomes; execution refuses dirty source/input content or existing consumed campaign claim; fresh case workers checkpoint observations atomically; publish outcomes in a subsequent separate commit; full seed replay never overwrites records
source_identity_policy: Bind every source_paths file at execution commit; preserve original source bytes and ancestry at those commits. Current-code validation may evolve and must independently satisfy numerical/accounting checks. Full seed replay requires the recorded NumPy/Python stack and one BLAS thread; structural/accounting checks draw no outcomes.
worker_timeout_rule: Terminate a case worker exceeding1800seconds, preserve every checkpointed observation and mark remaining scheduled outcomes worker_failed; never selectively rerun. Exclude resource/worker-failed cells from promotion and disclose unobserved work separately.
